audit_steps.description: Verify existence of valid PO for sampled orders
audit_steps.reason: Still required by Section 5.1 of policy v2.0 and KRI-001; no evidence of policy change affecting this step.

audit_steps.description: Confirm customer commitment evidenced by signed PO and secondary commitment document if required
audit_steps.reason: Prior exception rate (13.3%) and recommendation to introduce a secondary commitment document require expanding this step; policy clause 5.2 still applies.

audit_steps.description: Review credit rating classification, payment history, country risk, and Finance Manager sign-off for orders below B rating
audit_steps.reason: Prior exception (16.7%) and recommendation to enhance credit risk assessment beyond single-factor rating; KRI-003 and policy clause 5.3.2 still apply.

audit_steps.description: Confirm booking date aligns with PO receipt date
audit_steps.reason: No policy change or KRI/prior finding affecting this step; clause 5.4 still applies.

audit_steps.description: Verify system-based sign-off workflow is in place and used for all required approvals
audit_steps.reason: New step required per prior recommendation to formalize system-based sign-off and eliminate verbal approval gaps; supports compliance with policy clause 5.3.2.
